name: sus
description: SUS — Shahid UI UX Skill monorepo (ADR-001 layout). Private; not published.

scripts.typecheck: pnpm run --silent build && pnpm -r --if-present run typecheck
scripts.check: node scripts/check-continuation.mjs && node scripts/check-gates.mjs && node scripts/validate-skill.mjs && node scripts/validate-knowledge.mjs && node scripts/validate-playbooks.mjs || test $? -eq 3
scripts.verify: pnpm gates:full && pnpm lint && pnpm format:check && pnpm stylelint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm build && pnpm test
scripts.gates:full: node scripts/check-gates.mjs && node scripts/validate-skill.mjs && node scripts/validate-knowledge.mjs && node scripts/validate-playbooks.mjs || test $? -eq 3
scripts.hooks:install: git config core.hooksPath .githooks && echo "push gate installed (.githooks/pre-push)"
